metaTitle: Custom Poly Spandex Caps | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom poly spandex caps for your team or event. Perfect for bulk branding. Get a quote today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Poly spandex caps offer a snug, stretchable fit that holds its shape wear after wear, making them a popular choice for sports teams, outdoor events, and uniform programs. Unlike traditional cotton or structured caps, the four-way stretch fabric conforms to different head sizes comfortably, reducing the need for multiple size runs. These caps are lightweight, moisture-wicking, and easy to decorate with embroidery or screen printing, providing a clean, professional look for your logo.
heroAltText: A stack of custom poly spandex caps in various colors, featuring embroidered logos on the front panels.
